name: SEQUENCE
description: SEQUENCE returns a dynamic array of sequential numbers, shaped by the number of rows and columns, starting at a given value and stepping by a given increment.
tldr: Generates a sequence of numbers in an array.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: The number of rows in the result (must be a positive integer).

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: The number of columns in the result (defaults to 1).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The first value in the sequence (defaults to 1).

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: The increment between values (defaults to 1; may be negative).

basicExample.explanation: With only rows supplied, SEQUENCE returns a 5-row, 1-column array starting at 1, stepping by 1.

advancedExamples.title: A grid with a step
advancedExamples.scenario: Build a 3-row by 4-column table starting at 10, counting by 5.
advancedExamples.description: Supply rows, columns, start, and step
advancedExamples.explanation: The sequence starts at 10 and increments by 5 across the 12 cells.

advancedExamples.title: Counting down
advancedExamples.explanation: A negative step produces a decreasing sequence.

howItWorks: SEQUENCE generates a two-dimensional array of sequential numbers. rows and columns set the shape (columns defaults to 1), start is the first value (default 1), and step is the increment (default 1, and may be negative). The array spills into the sheet.

howToSteps.name: Set start and step
howToSteps.text: Optionally choose start value and increment.

howToSteps.name: Ensure spill space
howToSteps.text: Leave empty cells for the array.

limitations: rows and columns must be positive integers; only step may be negative.
Spills, so it needs empty space below/right.

commonErrors.cause: rows or columns is negative or non-integer.
commonErrors.fix: Use positive integers; only step may be negative.

commonErrors.cause: No room for the spilled array.
commonErrors.fix: Clear the cells in the spill range.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: SEQUENCE is a native function in Google Sheets with the same arguments and behavior.

faq.question: Is SEQUENCE in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, SEQUENCE is natively supported in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Can step be negative?
faq.answer: Yes, e.g. start 10 with step -1 counts downward.

faq.question: How do I make a row vector?
faq.answer: Set columns greater than 1 and rows equal to 1.
